content: The YIPF1 protein is a protein in humans that is encoded by the YIPF1 gene. Model organisms have been utilized to investigate the function of the YIPF1 protein. A conditional knockout mouse line, named Yipf1<sup>tm1a(EUCOMM)Wtsi</sup>, was developed as part of the International Knockout Mouse Consortium program. This program is a high-throughput mutagenesis initiative aimed at generating and distributing animal models of human diseases to researchers. The mouse line was created at the Wellcome Trust Sanger Institute. Both male and female mice from this line underwent a standardized phenotypic screening process to assess the effects of the gene deletion. A total of 23 different tests were conducted on the mutant mice. However, no significant abnormalities were identified in these tests.
